criteria.why: Needs a real iPhone running Safari against staging; Playwright WebKit on Windows cannot reproduce Safari's real CORS/credentials preflight behavior.
criteria.text: On a real iPhone (Safari) against staging, Annotate, Frame, Spotlight and the Finished player all play video.

criteria.command: bash -c 'U=$(grep -c "^\s*credentials: .include.,\s*$" src/frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.js || true); G=$(grep -c "isSameOrigin(.*) ? { credentials: .include. }" src/frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.js || true); [ "$U" -eq 0 ] && [ "$G" -eq 4 ]'
criteria.text: If it reproduces: the R2 redirect target answers the preflight with the right CORS headers, or the request is made without credentials.
